mapper.select: SELECT rr.recommend_result_id, rr.create_time, rr.age::TEXT AS age, rr.keyword, rr.image_route AS input_image, p.perfume_id, p.image_route AS perfume_image, p.brand, p.perfume_name FROM ( SELECT rr2.recommend_result_id, rr2.create_time, rr2.age, rr2.keyword, rr2.image_route FROM recommend_result rr2 WHERE rr2.member_id = #{memberId} AND rr2.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY rr2.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) rr INNER JOIN perfume_recommend pr ON pr.recommend_result_id = rr.recommend_result_id AND pr.is_delete = FALSE INNER JOIN perfume p ON p.perfume_id = pr.perfume_id AND p.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY rr.create_time DESC, pr.perfume_recommend_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommend_result WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_delete = FALSE

SELECT recommend_result_id, create_time, age::TEXT AS age, keyword, image_route AS input_image FROM recommend_result WHERE recommend_result_id = #{recommendResultId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_delete = FALSE

SELECT p.perfume_id, p.image_route AS perfume_image, p.brand, p.perfume_name, pr.reasons, a.accord_name, pn.note_level::TEXT AS note_level, n.note_name FROM perfume_recommend pr INNER JOIN perfume p ON p.perfume_id = pr.perfume_id AND p.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN perfume_accord pa ON pa.perfume_id = p.perfume_id AND pa.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN accord a ON a.accord_id = pa.accord_id AND a.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN perfume_note pn ON pn.perfume_id = p.perfume_id AND pn.is_delete = FALSE LEFT JOIN note n ON n.note_id = pn.note_id AND n.is_delete = FALSE WHERE pr.recommend_result_id = #{recommendResultId} AND pr.is_delete = FALSE ORDER BY pr.perfume_recommend_id ASC, pa.accord_order ASC, pn.note_level, n.note_name
